ngrams.purpose: Mixed into word drills when keystroke data shows slow/error-prone letter-pair transitions.

stages.title: Home Row Foundation
stages.description: First contact with the keyboard — just A S D F J K L ; . Accuracy matters far more than speed here.
stages.celebration: You've found your home base! Every word you'll ever type starts from these keys.

stages.title: Home Row Complete
stages.description: Adds G and H — the last two home row keys — and builds real fluency across the full row.
stages.celebration: Home row mastered, start to finish. Your fingers know the way now.

stages.title: Top Row Expansion
stages.description: Q W E R T Y U I O P — reaching up from home row.
stages.celebration: You've climbed the top row! That's over half the alphabet under your fingers.

stages.title: Bottom Row Expansion
stages.description: Z X C V B N M , . / — reaching down from home row. Completes the full alphabet.
stages.celebration: The entire alphabet is yours now. That's the hardest part behind you.

stages.title: Numbers & Symbols
stages.description: Number row plus common shifted symbols. A gentler accuracy bar — these reaches are genuinely harder.
stages.celebration: Numbers and symbols down. You can type anything a keyboard has to offer.

stages.title: Short Words
stages.description: 2-4 letter real words. First time letters become meaning instead of isolated targets.
stages.celebration: You just typed your first real words. This is where it starts feeling like writing.

stages.title: Words & Punctuation
stages.description: 4-8 letter words, each paired with a trailing punctuation mark to practice mid-flow symbol reaches.
stages.celebration: Words and punctuation together — you're typing the way real writing actually looks.

stages.title: Sentences & Paragraphs
stages.description: Short sentences first, building up to full paragraphs, forms, and code — real-world typing.
stages.celebration: You're a fluent typist. Every stage you climbed brought you here.
